candidate.answerReason: 25% is one quarter, so 25% of 40 is 40 ÷ 4 = 10.

methods.label: Find one quarter of the total
methods.explanation:
Since \(25\%=\frac14\), find one of four equal parts of 40:
\[
40 \div 4 = 10.
\]
The total is 40, and a part representing \(25\%\) is 10.
methods.levelReason: Converting 25% to one quarter and dividing 40 into four equal parts are appropriate for Grade 6.
